conflicts: City conflict: Yelp, MapQuest, Yahoo Local and Roadtrippers list 'Baldwin Park, CA 91706'; Atly files it under Irwindale, and the SWBA directory listed the previous club at this same address (Yan Long Badminton Club, now closed) as Irwindale. A Census incorporated-place lookup puts both the OSM street coordinate and Roadtrippers' coordinate (34.096187,-117.987324) inside the City of Irwindale. ZIP 91706 covers both cities; USPS's default place name for 91706 is Baldwin Park, with Irwindale accepted (from general ZIP reference, not re-checked live because the USPS lookup did not respond). So 'Baldwin Park' is the mailing city and Irwindale is the actual municipality. Unit is 'Ste B' on MapQuest/SWBA and 'Suite B' on Atly; Yelp omits it. The Census geocoder found no match, so the coordinate is street-level only (Nominatim). The club took over and renovated the former Yan Long Badminton Club space. Reviews disagree on air conditioning and hours.
pricingNote: Not published on the official site. Third-party listings/Yelp reviews (2025-2026) cite a ~$15 entrance fee plus a $1 card fee on first visit; one 2025 review cites ~$12. Atly mentions reservations ~$88/hour for four people (unverified).
